title: I-820 photos
text:
Reconstruction and expansion of the interchange at SH 121 and the shared section of freeway north of the interchange took place in the first half of the 2020s. By 2025 all work was complete. However, the work completed is the "interim" design for the interchange. In 2017 TxDOT provided a schematic of the ultimate design, which includes additional lanes, both general purpose and managed. As of 2026, there are no plans to proceed with the ultimate design.

These photos show the north side of the interchange at SH 121. There are two long connection ramps which are visible in the far distance in the photos looking south. In a future update I will add photos of the ramps.
